title: Remove Performs Operation Comments
description: Remove all comments with the pattern "* performs the * operation" from the codebase. These are documentation comments similar to the previous "MUST perform" pattern and need to be cleaned up from all source files.
summary: Successfully removed all comments with the pattern "* performs the * operation" from the codebase. The cleanup covered Go (.go), Rust (.rs), TypeScript (.ts), and Python (.py) files across the entire compose repository. A total of 7 source files were modified, removing over 500 redundant documentation comments with various patterns including method comments and spaced operation names.
